```{r}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

The question posed by this analysis is: does the global niche allow us to predict the structure of local communities?

In other words, if two species have very similar global niches, do they actually occur together locally?
And, Does this vary between 5m, 40m and 400m?

library(here)

# LOAD GLOBAL NICHE OVERLAP MATRICES

Expected co-occurrence is NOT calculated from global co-occurrence but from: GLOBAL NICHE SIMILARITY

```{r}
schoener_matrix <- read.csv(paste0(global_matrix_dir,"/schoener_matrix.csv"))
niche_jaccard_matrix <- read.csv(paste0(global_matrix_dir,"/niche_jaccard_matrix.csv"))
```

# LOAD LOCAL COOCURRENCE MATRICES

```{r}
jaccard_5m_mat <- read.csv(paste0(local_coocurrence,"/jaccard_distance_5m.csv"))
jaccard_40m_mat <- read.csv(paste0(local_coocurrence,"/jaccard_distance_40m.csv"))
jaccard_400m_mat <- read.csv(paste0(local_coocurrence,"/jaccard_distance_400m.csv"))

```

## Correct the matrices

```{r}
clean_names <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    as.character() %>%
    trimws() %>%
    gsub("\\.", " ", .) %>%
    gsub("_", " ", .) %>%
    gsub("\\s+", " ", .)
}

fix_square_matrix <- function(mat_or_df) {
  df <- as.data.frame(mat_or_df)
  sp_names <- clean_names(df$X)
  df <- df %>%
    select(-X)
  colnames(df) <- clean_names(colnames(df))
  rownames(df) <- sp_names
  mat <- as.matrix(df)
  mode(mat) <- "numeric"
  return(mat)
}
```

```{r}
schoener_matrix <- fix_square_matrix(schoener_matrix)
niche_jaccard_matrix <- fix_square_matrix(niche_jaccard_matrix)

jaccard_5m_mat <- fix_square_matrix(jaccard_5m_mat)
jaccard_40m_mat <- fix_square_matrix(jaccard_40m_mat)
jaccard_400m_mat <- fix_square_matrix(jaccard_400m_mat)
```

## Transform them to similarity

```{r}
local_sim_5m <- 1 - jaccard_5m_mat
local_sim_40m <- 1 - jaccard_40m_mat
local_sim_400m <- 1 - jaccard_400m_mat
```

```{r}
summary(local_sim_5m)
```

# FILTER COMMON SPECIES BY SCALE

## Scale 5 m

```{r}
common_5m <- intersect(
  rownames(local_sim_5m),
  rownames(niche_jaccard_matrix)
)

obs_5m <- local_sim_5m[
  common_5m,
  common_5m
]

exp_5m <- niche_jaccard_matrix[
  common_5m,
  common_5m
]
```

### CONVERT TO PAIRWISE FORMAT

```{r}
obs_5m_df <- as.data.frame(as.table(obs_5m))
```

```{r}
colnames(obs_5m_df) <- c(
  "sp1",
  "sp2",
  "observed_local"
)

head(obs_5m_df)
```

```{r}
exp_5m_df <- as.data.frame(as.table(exp_5m))

colnames(exp_5m_df) <- c(
  "sp1",
  "sp2",
  "expected_global"
)

head(exp_5m_df)
```

### Join observed and expected 

```{r}
pairwise_5m <- left_join(
  obs_5m_df,
  exp_5m_df,
  by = c("sp1", "sp2")
)

head(pairwise_5m)
```

### Remove duplicated and diagonal


```{r}
pairwise_5m <- pairwise_5m %>%
  filter(sp1 != sp2)

pairwise_5m <- pairwise_5m %>%
  filter(as.character(sp1) < as.character(sp2))

```


### calculate residual

```{r}
pairwise_5m$residual <-
  pairwise_5m$observed_local -
  pairwise_5m$expected_global
```

# QUANTILE REGRESSION

## Does the global niche predict local communities with low, intermediate, and high coexistence equally well?


```{r}
#install.packages("quantreg")
library(quantreg)

```

```{r}
rq_75 <- rq(
  observed_local ~ expected_global * scale,
  tau = 0.75,
  data = all_pairs,
  method = "fn"
)

summary(rq_75, se = "nid")
```


```{r}
rq_90 <- rq(
  observed_local ~ expected_global * scale,
  tau = 0.9,
  data = all_pairs,
  method = "fn"
)

summary(rq_90, se = "nid")
```


```{r}
summary(all_pairs$observed_local)

hist(all_pairs$observed_local, breaks = 100)

quantile(
  all_pairs$observed_local,
  probs = c(0.1,0.25,0.5,0.75,0.9)
)
```


```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(quantreg)

# Ensure the order of scales
all_pairs <- all_pairs %>%
  mutate(
    scale = factor(scale, levels = c("5m", "40m", "400m"))
  )

# Refit quantile regression models
rq_75 <- rq(
  observed_local ~ expected_global * scale,
  tau = 0.75,
  data = all_pairs,
  method = "fn"
)

rq_90 <- rq(
  observed_local ~ expected_global * scale,
  tau = 0.90,
  data = all_pairs,
  method = "fn"
)

# Create prediction data
pred_grid <- expand.grid(
  expected_global = seq(
    min(all_pairs$expected_global, na.rm = TRUE),
    max(all_pairs$expected_global, na.rm = TRUE),
    length.out = 200
  ),
  scale = levels(all_pairs$scale)
)

pred_75 <- pred_grid %>%
  mutate(
    observed_pred = predict(rq_75, newdata = pred_grid),
    tau = "τ = 0.75"
  )

pred_90 <- pred_grid %>%
  mutate(
    observed_pred = predict(rq_90, newdata = pred_grid),
    tau = "τ = 0.90"
  )

pred_all <- bind_rows(pred_75, pred_90)

# Colors
colors <- c(
  "5m"   = "#80cdc1",
  "40m"  = "#a6cee3",
  "400m" = "#ba8bc9"
)

# Figure
fig_quantile <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(
    data = all_pairs,
    aes(
      x = expected_global,
      y = observed_local,
      colour = scale
    ),
    alpha = 0.18,
    size = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = pred_all,
    aes(
      x = expected_global,
      y = observed_pred,
      colour = scale,
      linetype = tau
    ),
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ scale, nrow = 1) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = colors) +
  labs(
    x = "Expected co-occurrence from global niche overlap",
    y = "Observed local co-occurrence",
    colour = "Spatial scale",
    linetype = "Quantile"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

fig_quantile
```
```{r}
ggsave(file.path(save_path_figs, "global_niche_vs_local_cooccurrence_scales_facet_Quantile.png"), plot = fig_quantile, width = 7, height = 5, units = "in", dpi = 600)

```

# ANALYZE RESIDUALS

```{r}
ggplot(all_pairs,
       aes(x = residual,
           fill = scale)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.4)
```

```{r}
# colors <- c(
#   "5m"   = "#80cdc1",
#   "40m"  = "#1f78b4",
#   "400m" = "#540046"
# )

colors <- c(
  "5m"   = "#80cdc1",
  "40m"  = "#a6cee3",
  "400m" = "#ba8bc9ff"
)

all_pairs$scale <- factor(
  all_pairs$scale,
  levels = c("5m", "40m", "400m")
)

residual_boxplot <- ggplot(
  all_pairs,
  aes(
    x = scale,
    y = residual,
    fill = scale
  )
) +

  geom_violin(
    trim = TRUE,
    alpha = 0.35,
    color = NA,
    scale = "width"
  ) +

  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.12,
    color = "black",
    outlier.shape = NA,
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +

  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.7,
    color = "grey40"
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +

  labs(
    y = "Residual local co-occurrence",
    x = "Spatial scale"
  ) +

  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +

  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank()
  )

residual_boxplot
```

```{r}
ggsave(file.path(save_path_figs, "residual_boxplot.png"), plot = residual_boxplot, width = 7, height = 5, units = "in", dpi = 600)
```


```{r}
all_pairs %>%
  group_by(scale) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_residual = mean(residual),
    sd_residual = sd(residual),
    median_residual = median(residual)
  )
```

### compare variance


```{r}
# compare variance

kruskal.test(residual ~ scale,
             data = all_pairs)
```

### percentage of extreme residuals

```{r}
all_pairs %>%
  mutate(
    category = case_when(
      residual > 0.05 ~ "Higher than expected",
      residual < -0.05 ~ "Lower than expected",
      TRUE ~ "As expected"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(scale, category) %>%
  summarise(n = n()) %>%
  mutate(percent = 100 * n / sum(n))
```
